faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Millbrae?
faq.answer: Millbrae homeowners typically invest $6,500 to $15,000 for a full window replacement project covering 10–16 windows. This established Peninsula community features a mix of 1950s–1970s ranches and two-story homes, many in need of full-frame replacement after decades of use. Single window installation starts at approximately $570.

faq.question: Do I need a permit for window replacement in Millbrae?
faq.answer: Yes. Millbrae requires a building permit for window replacements. Our team handles all permit applications with the City of Millbrae's Building Department on your behalf.

faq.question: Which window brands does Deluxe Windows install in Millbrae?
faq.answer: For Millbrae's established Peninsula neighborhood profile, we most frequently install Milgard Tuscany vinyl for cost-effective replacements, Andersen 400-Series for homeowners preferring wood interiors, and Milgard Ultra fiberglass for superior performance in the coastal climate.

faq.question: Does Deluxe Windows serve all Millbrae neighborhoods?
faq.answer: Yes — we serve all Millbrae neighborhoods including Green Hills, Spring Valley, Millbrae Meadows, and all residential areas throughout the city. Zip code: 94030.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Millbrae?
faq.answer: Most Millbrae projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once windows arrive, typically four to eight weeks after ordering.
